title: Scenario capture requirements
responsibility: Expands required evidence across applicable states and viewports and separates missing from inapplicable states.

inputs.name: scenarioRequirements.scenario
inputs.description: The scenario manifest (ScenarioManifest) of one scenario file; the function reads only its `states` (id, coverage, reason) and `evidence` (id, kind, required, states, viewports), never its top-level `viewports`, `units` or `tests`. Only evidence with `required: true` yields captures, an evidence state that no `states` entry declares is dropped silently, and an evidence viewport id is copied into the requirement as given, without a lookup in the top-level `viewports`.

states.title: Caller-supplied error row
states.reason: No fixture renders the caller-supplied error row yet.

tests.target: bun x playwright test --config src/configs/shellPlaywrightConfig.ts explorer-shell-activity-list.spec.ts

examples.title: Recorded calls of a real function: what composeModes was given and what it returned

states.title: composeModes called for a hosted project, a writable local tip, a historical commit and a project that allows nothing

outputs.name: scenarioRequirements
outputs.description: The capture plan: `required` holds every capture a passing verification must contain, one per required state and evidence viewport (one per required state when the evidence names no viewports), taken only from evidence with `required: true`. `unproven` lists the `missing` states, which keep a scenario from passing, and `excluded` lists the `inapplicable` states; both carry each state's reason, or an empty string when the state has none.

unproven.reason: No fixture renders the caller-supplied error row yet.

errors.name: TypeError
errors.description: The function has no explicit `throw`: a manifest not shaped like ScenarioManifest, such as one whose `states` or `evidence` is not an array or holds a null entry, can make the JavaScript runtime throw a TypeError, and a manifest that passes scenarioManifestSchema never triggers it.
